gloss: to discontinue; to cut short; to terminate

definitions.explanation: To end something before its natural conclusion, often used for projects, broadcasts, or serializations.

definitions.gloss: to cut short; to break off
definitions.explanation: To abruptly end a conversation, meeting, or activity.

examples.japanese: {連載|れんさい}が{打|う}ち{切|き}られた。
その{番組|ばんぐみ}は{視聴率|しちょうりつ}{低迷|ていめい}で{打|う}ち{切|き}られた。
examples.english: That TV show was cancelled due to low ratings.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}{不足|ぶそく}でプロジェクトを{打|う}ち{切|き}ることになった。
examples.english: The project was discontinued due to budget shortfall.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{被災地|ひさいち}への{援助|えんじょ}を{打|う}ち{切|き}る{方針|ほうしん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced a policy to cut off aid to the disaster-affected areas.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げが{伸|の}びず、{新商品|しんしょうひん}の{生産|せいさん}は{半年|はんとし}で{打|う}ち{切|き}られることになった。
examples.english: Sales didn't grow, and production of the new product was terminated after six months.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}を{打|う}ち{切|き}った。
{時間切|じかんぎ}れで{議論|ぎろん}を{打|う}ち{切|き}った。
examples.english: We cut short the discussion because we ran out of time.

examples.japanese: {司会者|しかいしゃ}が{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}を{打|う}ち{切|き}った。
examples.english: The moderator cut short the Q&A session.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{態度|たいど}に{腹|はら}が{立|た}って、{交渉|こうしょう}を{打|う}ち{切|き}った。
examples.english: I got angry at the other party's attitude and broke off the negotiations.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{長引|ながび}いていたので、{部長|ぶちょう}が{途中|とちゅう}で{打|う}ち{切|き}って{結論|けつろん}をまとめた。
examples.english: The meeting was dragging on, so the department head cut it short and summarized the conclusion.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{打|う}ち{切|き}る → {打|う}ち{切|き}らない (negative)
・{打|う}ち{切|き}る → {打|う}ち{切|き}って (te-form)
・{打|う}ち{切|き}る → {打|う}ち{切|き}った (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {打|う}つ (to strike) + {切|き}る (to cut)

RELATED NOUN:
・{打|う}ち{切|き}り - discontinuation, cancellation
　Example: {連載|れんさい}{打|う}ち{切|き}り (serialization cancelled)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{番組|ばんぐみ}を{打|う}ち{切|き}る (to cancel a TV show)
・{連載|れんさい}を{打|う}ち{切|き}る (to end a serialization)
・{交渉|こうしょう}を{打|う}ち{切|き}る (to break off negotiations)
・{援助|えんじょ}を{打|う}ち{切|き}る (to cut off aid)

NOTE:
Often used in passive form {打|う}ち{切|き}られる when describing cancellations.
